QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] Traces of Color
QuestInfo.0: You looked high and low, but couldn't find a trace of color. Unbelievable...
QuestInfo.1: You looked high and low, but couldn't find a trace of color.\r\nPerhaps the monsters are carrying something colorful? Hunt 50 monsters in the Land of Contemplation while you search for color.
QuestInfo.2: Not even the monsters in the Land of Contemplation were carrying anything colorful. How is this possible?
